transistor-name-off-patent-1947.title: Jina Lilopuuliwa kwenye Patent
transistor-name-off-patent-1947.body: Tarehe 23 Desemba 1947, Bardeen na Brattain walionyesha transistor ya point-contact ya germanium katika Bell Labs. Shockley hakikuwa kwenye chumba hicho. Wavulaji walipata muundo wake mwenyewe uko karibu sana na patent ya Julius Lilienfeld ya 1925 na kuondoa jina lake kwenye hii.
transistor-name-off-patent-1947.coda: Mwaka 1956 wote watatu walinashiriki Tuzo ya Nobel ya Fizikia.

dartmouth-two-month-study-1956.title: Utafiti wa Miezi Miwili
dartmouth-two-month-study-1956.body: Mapendekezo ya 1955 ya McCarthy, Minsky, Rochester na Shannon yalikuwa ombi la utafiti wa miezi miwili wa watu kumi, kwenye dhana kwamba akili ingeweza kuelezwa kwa usahihi wa kutosha ili mashine iweze kuifanya. Kipindi cha 1956 kilikuwa wiki sita hadi nane; tu washiriki watatu walibaki kwa muda wote.
dartmouth-two-month-study-1956.coda: Jina walilochagua kwa uwanja huu, artificial intelligence, ndilo liliendelea.

traitorous-eight-lie-detector-1957.title: Barua ya Kigezo cha Uongo
traitorous-eight-lie-detector-1957.body: Mwezi Mei 1957, wahandisi wanne kwenye Shockley Semiconductor walihitaji William Shockley akubadilishwe kama meneja. Alikuwa amerekodi simu, kuzuia wafanyakazi kushiriki matokeo, na kuhitaji majaribio ya kigezo cha uongo. Tarehe 18 Septemba 1957, wanne hao walianzisha Fairchild Semiconductor badala yake.
traitorous-eight-lie-detector-1957.coda: Wikipedia inahesabu Intel na AMD kati ya makampuni mengi yanayoweza kufuatiliwa hadi spinoff hiyo.

kilby-noyce-six-months-1958-1959.title: Miezi Sita, Nguo Moja
kilby-noyce-six-months-1958-1959.body: Kilby alionyesha integrated circuit inayofanya kazi katika Texas Instruments mwezi Septemba 1958, sehemu zake zikishikamana kwa waya za nje. Noyce alitoa toleo la monolithic la silikoni katika Fairchild mwezi Julai 1959, linaloweza kutengenezwa kwa wingi. Mmoja wao hakukataa idhini ya mwingine kuwa mshiriki wa uumbaji.
kilby-noyce-six-months-1958-1959.coda: Kilby alikubali Tuzo ya Nobel ya 2000 peke yake. Noyce alikuwa amekufa mwaka 1990.

perceptron-conscious-machine-1958.title: Mashine Ingeamka
perceptron-conscious-machine-1958.body: Mwaka 1958 New York Times iliripoti kwamba perceptron ya Frank Rosenblatt ilikuwa embryo ya kompyuta ambayo Navy ilikuwa inatarajia kutembea, kuzungumza, kuona, kuandika, kujirepudisha na kujua uwepo wake. Mwaka 1969 kitabu cha Minsky na Papert kilithibitisha kwamba perceptron ya tabaka moja haiwezi kuhesabu XOR.
perceptron-conscious-machine-1958.coda: Mali kwa utafiti wa neural network ilikauka na haikurudi hadi miaka ya 1980.

hamilton-software-engineering.title: Mchezo unaendelea
hamilton-software-engineering.body: Wakati wa programu ya Apollo, Margaret Hamilton alianza kuuita kazi yake "software engineering" ili kuutofautisha na uhandisi wa hardware. Alisema hakuna mtu aliyesikia neno hilo hapo awali na ilikuwa mchezo unaendelea, hadi mhandisi wa hardware mwenye heshima akasimama katika mkutano na kukubali.
hamilton-software-engineering.coda: Mchezo ulikuwa ukiendelea kwa miaka mingi, kisha hakuna mtu aliyeeambia tena.

macau-seventeen-thousand.title: Robo elfu saba
macau-seventeen-thousand.body: Katika Oktoba 1961, shirika lililoundwa na Stanley Ho, Henry Fok, Yip Hon na Teddy Yip lilitawala monopoli ya kucheza kazi ya Macau. Walitoa patacas 3,167,000, robo elfu saba zaidi kuliko tofauti ya ushindani.
macau-seventeen-thousand.coda: Monopoli ambayo tofauti hiyo iliyonunua ilikuwa na zaidi ya miaka arobaini.

moores-law-ten-year-bet-1965.title: Kipato cha miaka kumi
moores-law-ten-year-bet-1965.body: Karatasi ya Moore ya 1965 ilatabiri idadi ya vipengele kwenye chipi itakuwa mara mbili kila mwaka kwa miaka kumi ijayo, ikifika takriban 65,000 kwa 1975. Mwaka 1975 alirekebisha kipindi cha kuzidisha kuwa miaka miwili. Mstari baadaye uliotajwa kama sheria ulikuwa utabiri wake mwenyewe, tayari umerekebishwa mara moja.
moores-law-ten-year-bet-1965.coda: Kwa 1995 Moore alisema neno lilikuwa limekuja kumaanisha karibu chochote katika tasnia ya chipi.

eliza-secretary-1966.title: Msaada na DOCTOR
eliza-secretary-1966.body: Mwaka 1966 Joseph Weizenbaum alitoa scripti ya DOCTOR ya ELIZA katika MIT, programu iliyokuwa ikigawanya sentensi za watumiaji wenyewe kurudisha kama maswali. Msaada wake mwenyewe kulingana na ripoti alimwomba aondoke chumbani ili aweze kuzungumza nayo peke yake.
eliza-secretary-1966.coda: Mfumo ambao hakuwa amekusudia baadaye ulijulikana kama athari ya ELIZA.

engelbart-royalties.title: Dola thelathini elfu
engelbart-royalties.body: SRI ilipata patent ya panya baada ya demo na, kulingana na hesabu yao, haikuwa na wazo halisi la thamani yake. Baada ya miaka michache ilibainika walikuwa wameipa leseni kwa Apple kwa kiasi cha takriban $40,000.
engelbart-royalties.coda: Engelbart hakupokea haki yoyote kwa kuifundisha.

lo.title: LO
lo.body: Charley Kline alianza kuingia kwenye mashine huko SRI kutoka UCLA. L ilifika. O ilifika. Kwenye G, upande wa mbali ulianguka.
lo.coda: Jambo la kwanza kusemwa kwenye mtandao lilikuwa herufi mbili: LO.

multics.title: Kompyuta kama huduma
multics.body: Multics haikubuniwa kama kompyuta bali kama huduma ya kompyuta: inayowashwa kila wakati, kama umeme, huku wapangaji wa mashine moja wakiwa wametengwa kutoka kwa kila mmoja. Ilitumwa ikiwa imechelewa na ghali, na Bell Labs iliondoka.
multics.coda: Miaka hamsini baadaye wazo hilo liliitwa tena kompyuta ya wingu.

rfc1.title: Ombi la Maoni
rfc1.body: Steve Crocker alilazimika kuandika sheria za kwanza kwa mwenyeji wachache wa mtandao. Hakuna aliyempa mamlaka, na aliogopa ingesomwa kama kujitwika mamlaka — kwa hivyo aliita aina hiyo Ombi la Maoni.
rfc1.coda: Kila sheria ambayo mtandao umekubaliana nayo tangu wakati huo bado inaitwa RFC.

pdp7.title: Mashine ambayo hakuna aliyetaka
pdp7.body: Baada ya Bell Labs kuacha Multics, Ken Thompson alikuwa na PDP-7 iliyotupwa na mwezi mmoja peke yake wakati mke wake na mtoto wake walikuwa San Diego. Alijipa wiki moja kwa kila kipande: kernel, shell, kihariri, mkusanyaji.
pdp7.coda: Wiki nne baadaye mashine ambayo hakuna aliyetaka ilikuwa ikiendesha Unix.

alarm-1202.title: Programu ya kengele 1202
alarm-1202.body: Dakika nne kutoka kwenye uso, kompyuta ya mwongozo ilitoa kengele tano: swichi ya rada ya kukutania iliyoachwa katika nafasi isiyo sahihi ilikuwa ikitumia mizunguko yake. Haikukwama. Iliacha kazi za kipaumbele cha chini, ilianza upya, na ikaendelea na kutua.
alarm-1202.coda: Kujua nini cha kuacha chini ya mzigo ndio somo la gharama kubwa.

mariner-1.title: Mia ya juu iliyokosewa
mariner-1.body: Mariner 1 iliharibiwa sekunde 293 baada ya kufunguliwa. Beacon ya ndani ilikwisha, na wakati milinganyo ya mwongozo ilikuwa ikionekwa kwenye programu, juu ilikuwa imeondolewa kutoka R. Juu ilimaanisha kuchukua wastani.
mariner-1.coda: Vyombo vya habari vilipata juu vigumu kueleza na kuandika mstari wa chini. Mstari wa chini ulikaa.

mother-of-all-demos.title: Mama wa Onyesho Yote
mother-of-all-demos.body: Engelbart alipewa dakika nane na kumi. Terminal yake ilikuwa ikifanya kazi juu ya mistari ya simu hadi mashine iliyoko mbali kwa maili thelathini, na alionyesha panya, viungo vya hyper, dirisha, kugawana skrini, na watu wawili wakirekebisha hati moja kwa wakati mmoja.
mother-of-all-demos.coda: Watu elfu moja waliona, kisha wakarudi kwa kadi za punch kwa miaka kumi nyingine.

conway.title: Karatasi iliyokataliwa
conway.body: Melvin Conway alisimulia uchunguzi kwamba muundo wa mfumo hatimaye unafanana na muundo wa mawasiliano wa shirika lililolijenga, na kutuma "How Do Committees Invent?" kwa Harvard Business Review. Walikataa kwa sababu hakuwa amethibitisha nadharia yake. Datamation ilikuza mwaka 1968.
conway.coda: Fred Brooks baadaye alijulisha nadharia isiyo thibitishwa na kuuita sheria ya Conway.

apollo-burn-baby-burn.title: Choma, Baby, Choma
apollo-burn-baby-burn.body: Mchakato mkuu wa kuanzisha moto wa moduli ya mwezi unajulikana kama BURN_BABY_BURN katika chanzo. Jina si kuhusu msukumo; iliborolewa kutoka kwa maneno ya DJ wa redio ya roho ya siku.
apollo-burn-baby-burn.coda: Mstari bado uko bila kuhariri katika hazina ya umma.

waterfall.title: Mchoro ulikuwa mfano wa kinyume
waterfall.body: Katika "Managing the Development of Large Software Systems" Winston Royce alichora chati ambayo tasnia ingejua kama mfano wa waterfall, kisha alisema: "Ninaamini katika dhana hii, lakini utekelezaji ulioelezewa hapo juu ni hatari na unahamasisha kushindwa." Sehemu nyingine ya karatasi ni juu ya kufanya iwe mzunguko.
waterfall.coda: Tasnia ilibadilisha mchoro na kuondoa sentensi.

moth.title: Kosa la Kwanza Halisi
moth.body: Panya ilichukuliwa kutoka kwenye relay ya Harvard Mark II na kuwekwa kwenye kitabu cha rekodi. Mstari upande wake unarejelewa kama asili ya neno, lakini inasema: kesi ya kwanza halisi ya kosa kukutwa.
moth.coda: Wahandisi walikuwa wakisema kosa tangu Edison. Makumbusho yanashuku ukurasa huo hata uko mkononi mwa Hopper.

intel-4004-busicom-rights-1971.title: Chipi Iliyomilikiwa na Kampuni ya Kikokotozi
intel-4004-busicom-rights-1971.body: Mnamo 1969 Busicom ya Japan ilimwagiza Intel kuunda chipset ya kikokotozi, chini ya mkataba unaowapa haki za muundo kwa Busicom ingawa kazi ilifanywa ndani ya Intel. Mnamo 1971 mhandisi Federico Faggin alibadilisha bei ya chini kwa uondoshaji wa hali hiyo ya kipekee.
intel-4004-busicom-rights-1971.coda: Uuzaji wa jumla wa Intel 4004 ulianza mwezi Julai huo.

pong-coin-overflow.title: Sanduku la Pesa Lilijaa
pong-coin-overflow.body: Mnamo Agosti 1972, Atari ilikuweka prototipi ya Pong katika bar ya Sunnyvale. Baada ya siku chache, mwenyeji aliripoti imeharibika. Mhandisi Al Alcorn alisafiri kuitengua na akagundua kosa sikuwa la umeme: mekanismu ya pesa ilikata kwa sababu ilijaa kwa viungo vya robo.
pong-coin-overflow.coda: Kosa sikuwa la waya; ilikuwa pesa nyingi sana.

wozniak-breakout-bonus.title: Gawio
wozniak-breakout-bonus.body: Mnamo 1973 Atari ilimwomba Steve Jobs kupunguza bodi ya Breakout, ikimlipa $100 kwa kila chipi iliyondolewa. Jobs alimwomba Wozniak kumsaidia, akahakikisha nusu. Wozniak akakata chipi 50. Jobs alisema jumla ilikuwa $700, kwa hivyo sehemu ya Wozniak ilikuwa $350. Miaka kumi baadaye Wozniak alijifunza tuzo halisi ilikuwa $5,000.
wozniak-breakout-bonus.coda: Wozniak alisema angeampa Jobs pesa zote kama angeulizwa.

unix-not-expected-to-understand.title: Haikuwa Inatarajiwa Kueleweka
unix-not-expected-to-understand.body: Unix ya Toleo la Sita ina mstari 'You are not expected to understand this' katika slp.c, ukiambatana na kodi ya kurudisha stack ya mchakato iliyojengwa juu ya tabia za compiler ya PDP-11. Dennis Ritchie baadaye alisema alimaanisha kwa njia mwalimu anasema hii haipo kwenye mtihani.
unix-not-expected-to-understand.coda: Rutini ilikuandikwa upya kwa Unix ya Toleo la Saba.

vi-adm3a-keys.title: Mishale Iliyochongwa kwenye Kifungo cha Herufi
vi-adm3a-keys.body: Bill Joy aliuandika vi Berkeley mwaka 1977 kwenye terminali ya Lear Siegler ADM-3A ambayo haikuwa na vifungo vya mishale; h, j, k na l vilichongwa na mishale na kuwa vifungo vya kusogea. Amri fupi za herufi moja zilitoka kwa kuandika mbele ya modem ya 300-baud ambayo ilikuwa polepole sana kufuata.
vi-adm3a-keys.coda: Vifungo vilivyotajwa baadaye kwa falsafa ya muundo vilianza kama njia ya kuzunguka terminali isiyo na vifungo vya mishale.

kildall-flying.title: Upepo Usiokuwa Umethibitishwa
kildall-flying.body: Mwaka 1980 IBM ilikuja kuchukua leseni ya CP/M. Gary Kildall alikuwa akipepea programu kwa mteja; mke wake Dorothy alishughulikia mazungumzo ya kufungua. Bill Gates baadaye alisema kwa waandishi wa habari Kildall alikuwa amekwenda "kupanda kwa ghafla." Mshauri mkuu wa IBM, Jack Sams, alisema hakumkuta Kildall kabla.
kildall-flying.coda: Hesabu mbili za mkutano huo hazijawekwa sawa kamwe.

trusting-trust.title: Mawazo juu ya Kuaminiana Trust
trusting-trust.body: Mazungumzo ya Turing ya Thompson yalielezea kompila inayoweka mlango wa nyuma katika programu ya kuingia, na kuweka upya mchezo wote wakati inapopanga kompila. Tengeneza upya kutoka chanzo safi na mlango wa nyuma unaishi.
trusting-trust.coda: Hauwezi kuaminia msimbo ambao haukuunda mwenyewe kabisa.

arm-one-person-company-1985.title: Kampuni ya Chipi ya Mtu Mmoja
arm-one-person-company-1985.body: Acorn, ambayo ilijitambulisha kwa kompyuta za elimu, ilianza utafiti wa RISC mwaka 1983. Zيارات kwa mhandisi wa chipi wa ushindani ilionyesha kwamba sasisho za 6502 zilitoka kwa kampuni ya mtu mmoja, na walihitimisha wengine hakuna zaidi.
arm-one-person-company-1985.coda: ARM1 ilifika tarehe 26 Aprili 1985 na kufanya kazi kwenye uamshaji wa kwanza.

copyleft-all-rights-reversed.title: Haki Zote Zimepinduliwa
copyleft-all-rights-reversed.body: Mtu alimpeleka Richard Stallman barua iliyoleweka "Copyleft — haki zote zimepinduliwa," mchezo wa taarifa ya kawaida. Baada ya Symbolics kuboresha mtafsiri wake wa Lisp na kukataa kushiriki uboreshaji kurudi, alitumia sheria ya haki za uhuishaji mwenyewe kuandika leseni inayohitaji dhamana tofauti.
copyleft-all-rights-reversed.coda: Leseni ya Umma ya Jumla ilifuata mnamo Februari 1989.

tetris-unpaid-decade.title: Mkate Usiozidiwa
tetris-unpaid-decade.body: Mwaka 1985 Pajitnov aliandika Tetris kama mtumishi wa serikali wa Akademia ya Sayansi ya USSR; haki zilikuwa za Kituo cha Kompyuta, si kwake. Leseni za Magharibi ziliitirika mikono mingi kabla ya kufika Nintendo, na mchezo uliuza nakala za mamilioni.
tetris-unpaid-decade.coda: Haki ziliirudishwa kwake mwaka 1996, miaka kumi na moja baada ya kuandika.

euv-twenty-three-hours-2018.title: Saa Kumi na Tatu kwa Wafer Moja
euv-twenty-three-hours-2018.body: Hiroo Kinoshita wa NTT alionyesha kwanza picha za lithografia ya ultraviolet ya kipekee mwaka 1986. Prototaiti ya ASML ya 2006 ilichukua saa kumi na tatu kuonyesha wafer moja. EUV haikufika uzalishaji hadi 2018, katika mashine MIT Technology Review iliyoiita ile iliyolinda sheria ya Moore.
euv-twenty-three-hours-2018.coda: Mwaka 2022 skana ya EUV ya uzalishaji ilisimamia takriban wafer mia mbili kwa saa.

tsmc-foundry-fifty-six-1987.title: Kibanda kwa Miaka Arobaini na Sita
tsmc-foundry-fifty-six-1987.body: Morris Chang, alizaliwa 1931, alipanda kuwa naibu mkurugenzi wa kundi wa operesheni za semikondakta duniani kote kwa Texas Instruments, kisha alitumikia kama rais na COO wa General Instrument, kisha aliongoza ITRI ya Taiwan. Mwaka 1987, kwa miaka arobaini na sita, aliunga TSMC, ambayo haipendekezi chipi yoyote inayozalisha.
tsmc-foundry-fifty-six-1987.coda: Ilikuwa kibanda kwanza duniani kuzalisha tu.

huawei-diet-pills.title: Biashara ya Kwanza ya Huawei Haikuwa Teknolojia
huawei-diet-pills.body: Huawei ilisajiliwa kwa kiasi cha yuan 21,000 tarehe 15 Septemba 1987, ikijitaja kuwa kampuni ya teknolojia. Ilianza kwa kuuza bidhaa, ikiwa ni pamoja na pilili za lishe, kisha iliuza tena swichi za HAX zilizotengenezwa Hong Kong kwa faida. Swichi yake mwenyewe, BH01, ilikusanywa kwa mkono mwaka 1989 tu.
huawei-diet-pills.coda: Baada ya miaka minne, kampuni ilichora bodi yake ya mzunguko kwa mara ya kwanza.

morris.title: Pimo
morris.body: Morris alitaka kujua ukubwa wa intaneti, kwa hivyo aliandika programu inayojikopia. Ili kusimamisha mabaka yasiyoonyesha jibu la kuambukizwa tayari, alitoa nafasi ya moja kwa saba ya kuambukiza tena.
morris.coda: Nafasi ile ya moja kwa saba ilifukuza takriban mabaka 6,000 ya 60,000 yaliyokuwa mtandaoni wakati huo.

naur.title: Programu si ni bidhaa
naur.body: Naur alidai kwamba programu haishi katika chanzo chake bali kama nadharia, inayoshikiliwa na watu waliokuandika, ya kwa nini tatizo linatatuliwa kwa njia hii. Chanzo ni upimaji unaopoteza data wa hiyo.
naur.coda: Alipita kusema kipindi mwisho wa kudumisha nadharia anaondoka ni kifo cha programu.

mit-license-171-words.title: Maneno 171
mit-license-171-words.body: Kundi la MIT kilichokuwa likiandika utekelezaji wa TCP/IP kilikuwa kikitaka kuepuka mazungumzo ya kisheria, hivyo walitoa programu hiyo chini ya taarifa ya takriban maneno 171. Uandishi mfupi huo sasa unafunika karibu theluthi moja ya miradi yote iliyopewa leseni kwenye GitHub, zaidi ya leseni yoyote nyingine.
mit-license-171-words.coda: Uandishi umekaa hasa usiobadilika tangu ulipoundwa.

photoshop-display-origin.title: Ilikuwa Inaitwa Display Kwanza
photoshop-display-origin.body: Mnamo 1988, Thomas Knoll, mwanafunzi wa chuo kikuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Michigan, aliandika programu ndogo ya kuangalia picha za grayscale kwenye skrini ya Mac ya monochrome. Alipata jina Display, kisha ImagePro, kisha Photoshop, kabla ya kaka yake John kumonyesha Adobe, ambayo ilitoa leseni mwaka huo.
photoshop-display-origin.coda: Adobe ilinunua haki zote kabisa mnamo 1995, kwa dola milioni 34.5.

sosumi-so-sue-me.title: Hivyo Nilisumbua
sosumi-so-sue-me.body: Mnamo 1991, idara ya kisheria ya Apple ilikataa jina la sauti ya onyo "Let It Beep" kama kimekuwa muziki sana, chini ya makubaliano yanayozuia Apple Computer kutumia alama za biashara zinazohusiana na muziki. Mhandisi wa sauti Jim Reekes aliandika tena "so sue me," kisha akaitumia kama "sosumi."
sosumi-so-sue-me.coda: Sauti ilisafirishwa katika Mac OS kwa takriban miaka thelathini kabla ya Big Sur kuibadilisha mnamo 2020.

www-royalty-free.title: Siku iliyosimama ikikosa
www-royalty-free.body: Tarehe 30 Aprili 1993 CERN ilifanya protokoli na msimbo wa Mtandao wa Dunia uwe upatikanaji bila ada. Mtu yeyote angekuwa na uwezo wa kuchukua, bila kulipa na bila kuuliza.
www-royalty-free.coda: Hakuna mtu aliyelipa ada ya kutumia tangu hapo.

doom-ftp-crash.title: Seva Ili Hawaikuwasha
doom-ftp-crash.body: Tarehe 10 Desemba 1993, id Software ilitoa kipindi cha kwanza cha Doom kama shareware, ikiamini katika mauzo ya sehemu nyingine. Wakipakia kwenye seva ya FTP ya Chuo Kikuu cha Wisconsin, wakaona watu wengi tayari wamekusanyika hadi timu yenyewe haikuweza kuunganisha.
doom-ftp-crash.coda: Upakiaji ulikamilika karibu usiku; maelfu kumi ya kupakua kwa wakati mmoja iliharibu mtandao wa chuo kikuu.

zlib-two-authors.title: Safu ya Kukandamiza ya Wawili
zlib-two-authors.body: zlib ipo ndani ya Linux, macOS, iOS na vizazi vifuatavyo vya konsole za mchezo; Git na OpenSSH wote wanategemea kukandamiza. Watu wawili walikuandika toleo la kwanza la umma mwaka 1995.
zlib-two-authors.coda: Mstari wa uandishi haukuongezwa jina la tatu.

byd-battery-to-car.title: Kampuni ya Betri Ilinunua Mfumo wa magari
byd-battery-to-car.body: BYD ilianzishwa katika wilaya ya Longgang, Shenzhen mnamo Februari 10, 1995, ikitengeneza betri za nikeli-kadmium na nikeli-metal hydride, kisha kuingia kwenye seli za lithiamu-ion mwaka 1996. Mwaka 2003, mtengenezaji wa betri alinunua Xi'an Qinchuan Automobile, na kuibadilisha jina kuwa BYD Auto.
byd-battery-to-car.coda: Miaka miwili baadaye, gari lake la kwanza la ndani, F3, lilianza kuuzwa.

ariane-501.title: Sekunde thelathini na saba
ariane-501.body: Sekunde thelathini na saba, mfumo wa marejeleo ya inertial ulibadilisha nambari ya 64-bit float kuwa 16-bit integer na kufurika; karibu sekunde arobaini, gari lilivunjika. Utaratibu huo ulikuja bila mabadiliko kutoka Ariane 4 na haukuwa na sababu ya kuendelea kufanya kazi baada ya kuruka.
ariane-501.coda: Takriban dola milioni 370, zilizotumika kwenye msimbo ambao ulipaswa kuzimwa.

deep-blue-move-44-1997.title: Hitilafu ya Hatua ya Arobaini na Nne
deep-blue-move-44-1997.body: Katika mchezo wa kwanza wa mchujo wa 1997, Kasparov alimshinda Deep Blue kwa hatua arobaini na tano. Hatua ya arobaini na nne ya Deep Blue inadaiwa kuwa matokeo ya hitilafu: kwa kushindwa kuamua hatua inayopendekezwa ndani ya utafutaji wake, injini ilirudi kwenye njia ya usalama.
deep-blue-move-44-1997.coda: Baada ya kupoteza mchezo wa pili, Kasparov alimshutumu IBM kwa udanganyifu.

curl-one-maintainer.title: Stack ya Protocol ya Mtu Mmoja
curl-one-maintainer.body: Kumbukumbu za curl zenyewe zina weka libcurl kwenye vifaa takribani bilioni kumi, vinavyofanya kazi kwenye mifumo 110 ya uendeshaji na miundo 28 ya CPU. Mradi umekuwa ukibeba jina la Daniel Stenberg kama mtunza kiongozi tangu ulipobadilishwa jina kuwa curl mnamo 1998.

book-of-mozilla-verses.title: Kitabu cha Mozilla
book-of-mozilla-verses.body: Kuingiza about:mozilla kwenye baa ya anwani inaonyesha Kitabu cha Mozilla, mashairi ya mwisho wa dunia yanayoweka 'shetani' dhidi ya 'Mammon' ambayo kila kizazi cha kivinjari kinabadilisha. Nambari za mashairi si alama za sura: ni tarehe za toleo.
book-of-mozilla-verses.coda: Shairi jipya, 6:27, kilipangishwa kwanza kwenye toleo la Firefox Nightly mnamo 2020.

http-418-teapot.title: Mimi ni Teapot
http-418-teapot.body: RFC 2324, iliyochapishwa Aprili 1, 1998, inafafanua hali 418 kama "Mimi ni teapot" na kujiandaa kama Habari, si kiwango. Aprili 1, 2014, RFC 7168 ilikuongeza ili kufunika ujanishi wa chai. Kodi bado haijawahi kuwa kiwango halisi.
http-418-teapot.coda: Nyaraka zote mbili zimebaki Habari; kodi ya hali ilipangishwa kwenye seva halisi vivyo hivyo.

open-source-coined-1998.title: Kutengeneza Open Source
open-source-coined-1998.body: Mnamo Februari 1998, Christine Peterson alitoa "open source" kwa sababu wageni walikuwa wakisikia "free software" kama bei, si uhuru. Katika mkutano wa VA Research tarehe Februari 5, Todd Anderson alisukuma neno ndani ya mazungumzo badala ya kuilenga rasmi, akihakikisha lisambae kwa upeo wake.
open-source-coined-1998.coda: Kikundi baadaye kilijaribu kuweka alama ya biashara kwa msemo na kushindwa.

netscape-source-1998.title: Si Open Kabisa
netscape-source-1998.body: Tarehe 22 Januari 1998 Netscape ilitangaza kwamba chanzo cha kivinjari chake kitatolewa, na mshirika Jamie Zawinski alisajili mozilla.org. Lakini leseni walioandika ilibaki na mlango mmoja wazi: Netscape yenyewe ingeweza kuendelea kuunganisha kodi ileile kwenye bidhaa za kibinafsi.
netscape-source-1998.coda: Netscape ilinunuliwa na AOL takribani mwaka mmoja baadaye.

bsd-75-acknowledgments.title: Mashukuru Miasini
bsd-75-acknowledgments.body: Leseni la BSD la asili lilihitaji kila tangazo liweke jina la kila mchango wa mwandishi. Mwaka 1997, ujenzi mmoja wa NetBSD ulikuwa na mashukuru miasini kama hayo, yasiyofaa na GPL. Meneja wa leseni wa Berkeley alifuta kifungu hicho tarehe 22 Julai, 1999.
bsd-75-acknowledgments.coda: Saini ya ofisi moja ilifuta kifungu kilichozidishwa kwa mwaka kumi.

red-hat-ipo-1999.title: Bei ya Programu Bure
red-hat-ipo-1999.body: Red Hat ilikuza msimbo wa chanzo wa bidhaa yake kuu na kulipia badala ya huduma, mafunzo na muunganisho. Tarehe 11 Agosti, 1999 kampuni ilifunguliwa. Ongezeko la siku ya kwanza lilikuwa la nane kubwa katika historia ya Wall Street wakati huo.
red-hat-ipo-1999.coda: Mwenzi Bob Young alibadilishwa kama CEO miezi minne baadaye.

multics-shutdown.title: Mwisho
multics-shutdown.body: Tarehe 30 Oktoba, 2000, usanidi wa mwisho wa Multics uliofungwa kwa asili kwenye vifaa vya Honeywell ulifungwa katika Idara ya Ulinzi wa Kitaifa ya Kanada huko Halifax, Nova Scotia.
multics-shutdown.coda: Miaka thelathini na tano baada ya mradi kuanza.

sqlite-no-license.title: Hati ya Kumbukumbu Isiyo na Leseni
sqlite-no-license.body: Ukurasa wa SQLite unaakisi zaidi ya triliioni ya faili za hati zinazofanya kazi duniani kote, kwa sababu kila simu ya mkononi peke yake ina hundi, ikikuweka ya pili tu baada ya zlib kati ya programu zinazotumika. Hakuna leseni, kwa sababu waandishi walitoa kila mstari kwa umma.
sqlite-no-license.coda: Kampuni zinazotaka kufunika kisheria zinunua dhamana tofauti ya haki.

smic-tsmc-lawsuit.title: Mishahara Miwili ya SMIC
smic-tsmc-lawsuit.body: SMIC ilianzishwa mwaka 2000 na Richard Chang, mhandisi wa zamani wa TSMC, miongoni mwa wengine. TSMC ilishinda mara mbili kwa uchochezi wa siri za biashara; katika kesi ya 2009, juri ilipata SMIC inayohusika kwa hesabu 61 kati ya 65 zilizokuwa dhidi yake.
smic-tsmc-lawsuit.coda: Mwaka 2010, SMIC ilifanya makubaliano na TSMC kwa dola milioni 200 na takriban asilimia 8 ya hisa zake.

api-mandate.title: Barua
api-mandate.body: Kulingana na chapisho lililotoka kwa bahati mbaya mwaka 2011, Bezos aliamuru mwaka 2002 kwamba timu zifichue kila kitu kupitia violesura vya huduma: hakuna uunganishaji wa moja kwa moja, hakuna kusoma hifadhi ya timu nyingine, hakuna milango ya nyuma.
api-mandate.coda: Mwandishi wa chapisho hilo alikuwa ameanisha kwa wenzake peke yao.

hupu-rumours.title: Mtafisi wa habari
hupu-rumours.body: Mwaka 2004 mwanafunzi wa China aliyekuwa akifanya daktari wa uhandisi wa mitambo huko Chicago alianza jukwaa la mpira wa kikapu kwa muda wa bure. Kazi ilikuwa hasa kutafsiri habari na habari za NBA kwa Kichina na kuzisafisha.
hupu-rumours.coda: Miaka nane baadaye jukwaa lilifungua duka la mtandao la kwake.

jd-the-other-name.title: Nusu nyingine ya jina
jd-the-other-name.body: Jukwaa la rejareja lililoanza mtandaoni mwaka 2004 lilichukua jina lake kutoka kwa watu wawili: mwanzilishi wake, Liu Qiangdong, na Gong Xiaojing, mwanamke aliyekuwa akichumbiana naye kwanza. Herufi moja kutoka kwa kila mmoja.

douban-hutong.title: Kutajwa kwa jina la kichochoro
douban-hutong.body: Tovuti iliyoanza kutumika tarehe 6 Machi 2005 haijatajwa kwa jina la sitiari. Yang Bo aliandika chanzo chake katika mkahawa karibu na Douban Hutong huko Beijing, na akachukua jina la kichochoro hicho.
douban-hutong.coda: Miaka ishirini na moja baadaye, tovuti bado inabeba jina hilo.

git-information-manager-hell.title: Meneja wa Taarifa kutoka Kuzimu
git-information-manager-hell.body: Tarehe 7 Aprili 2005, Linus Torvalds alifanya toleo la kwanza la git. Ujumbe unasoma: Initial revision of "git", the information manager from hell. Anwani ya mwandishi juu yake ni torvalds@ppc970.osdl.org.
git-information-manager-hell.coda: Anwani hiyo inaelekeza kwenye mashine ya majaribio ya PowerPC 970 katika OSDL.

knuth-reward-check.title: Benki ya San Serriffe
knuth-reward-check.body: Donald Knuth analipa $2.56 kwa kosa kila moja kilichopatikana katika vitabu vyake, kinachochorwa kutoka Benki ya San Serriffe ya kufikiri. Hadi Machi 2005, cheki alizochora zilijumlisha zaidi ya $20,000.
knuth-reward-check.coda: Wapokeaji wengi hufunga cheki badala ya kuweka ndani.

dji-helicopter-first.title: DJI Ilianza na Helikopta
dji-helicopter-first.body: Frank Wang alihitimu chuo kikuu cha Hong Kong University of Science and Technology mwaka 2006 na alikuwa mmoja wa kuanzisha DJI Shenzhen pamoja na wanafunzi wenzake. Bidhaa yake ya kwanza ilikuwa mfumo wa kudhibiti upepo wa helikopta; toleo la kwanza la XP3.1, lililochakaa, lilitolewa mwaka 2008.
dji-helicopter-first.coda: Timu baadaye iligundua wamiliki wengi wa gimbal walikuwa wakiamka juu ya multirotors, si helikopta.

dropbox-hn.title: Jibu hilo
dropbox-hn.body: Houston alitoa demo la Dropbox kwenye Hacker News. Jibu la mashuhuri lilionyesha kwamba unaweza kufanya mwenyewe kwa akaunti ya FTP, curlftpfs na SVN, na kwamba haikuonekana kama ingekusanya pesa.
dropbox-hn.coda: Miaka kumi na moja baadaye, wakati wa IPO, Houston alisema ilikuwa thread yake ya upendo kwenye tovuti.

butterfield.title: Marahawa mbili kutoka kwa mabaki
butterfield.body: Mchezo wa Butterfield, Game Neverending, ulisimama, na timu ilichora sehemu ya picha-kugawana kama Flickr. Miaka nane baadaye mchezo wake wa pili, Glitch, ulifungwa, na timu ilichora zana ya mazungumzo walikuwa wamejenga kwa wenyewe: Slack.
butterfield.coda: Mara zote mbili bidhaa ya pili ilikuwa inayoonekana tu baada ya kitu kikuu kufungwa.

blockbuster.title: Mamilioni hamsini
blockbuster.body: Hastings na Randolph waliruka Dallas kuuza Netflix kwa Blockbuster kwa mamilioni hamsini, na kuendesha upande wa mtandao kwa ajili yao. Kulingana na Randolph, CEO upande wa pili wa meza alitumia mkutano kukandamiza kicheko.
blockbuster.coda: Blockbuster ilikuja kwa ajili ya uovu miaka kumi baadaye.

y2k.title: Hakuna kilichotokea
y2k.body: Gartner ilikadiria gharama ya Y2K duniani kote kuwa biliuni tatu hadi sita za dola, na watu mia za elfu walibadilisha miaka ya tarakimu mbili mstari kwa mstari. Usiku huo, mtandao ulisimama, benki zilisimama, ndege zilienda.
y2k.coda: Miaka minne baadaye mwanafunzi wa uchumi alichapisha kazi inayodai sehemu kubwa ya pesa ilikuwa imepotea.

unsourced.title: Imeaminishwa kwa mtu yeyote
unsourced.body: "640K inapaswa kuwa ya kutosha kwa mtu yeyote" — jibu la Gates mwenyewe ni kwamba hakuna maelezo, kwamba maneno yanapanda kama habari na yanarudiwa. "Soko la dunia kwa kompyuta tano" — Thomas Watson alisema tano, mwaka 1953, kuhusu maagizo aliyotarajia kwa mashine moja, IBM 701.

homebrew-volunteer-team.title: Hifadhi Isiyo na Mfadhili
homebrew-volunteer-team.body: Homebrew ni meneja wa pakiti chaguo-msingi kwenye mashine nyingi za wasanidi wa Mac; mwaka 2013 ilikuwa mbele ya GitHub yote kwa washiriki. Max Howell aliuandika toleo lake la kwanza mwaka 2009. Leo inasimamiwa na timu ya watu 34, wote bila malipo.
homebrew-volunteer-team.coda: Historia yake ya ufadhili ni Kickstarter moja na akaunti ya Open Source Collective.

xiaomi-software-first.title: Bidhaa ya Kwanza ya Xiaomi Sikuwa Simu
xiaomi-software-first.body: Xiaomi ilianzishwa tarehe 6 Aprili, 2010. Agosti na Desemba ya mwaka huo ilitoa toleo la beta la mfumo wa uendeshaji MIUI na programu ya mawasiliano Miliao, zote programu.
xiaomi-software-first.coda: Simu ya kwanya ya kampuni haikuwasilishwa hadi Agosti ya mwaka uliofuata.

ritchie-same-week.title: Wiki Moja
ritchie-same-week.body: Dennis Ritchie, pamoja na Ken Thompson, alitengeneza Unix na lugha ya programu C. Alipatikana amekufa nyumbani kwake New Jersey tarehe 12 Oktoba, 2011, akiwa na miaka 70. Steve Jobs alikuwa amekufa wiki moja kabla, tarehe 5 Oktoba. Wataalamu baadaye walitaja kazi ya Ritchie ilikuwa msingi wa teknolojia Apple ilijenga utajiri wake.

leap-second.title: Sekunde ya ziada
leap-second.body: Sekunde ya leap ilikuongezwa ili saa za atomiki zibaki kwa hatua na mzunguko wa ardhi. Kernel hakumwambia mfumo wake wa saa, saa za urefuu wa juu ziliangaza mapema, na vichujio vilizunguka. Reddit, Mozilla na LinkedIn ziliimika; mkombozi wa ndege alikuza abiria kwa mkono.
leap-second.coda: Muda haongezeki kwa mtindo wa monotonic. Nambari inadhani inafanya hivyo.

gregorian-1752-eleven-days.title: Siku Kumi na Moja Zilizopotea
gregorian-1752-eleven-days.body: Tarehe 2 Septemba 1752, kalenda ya Uingereza iliruka hadi 14 Septemba, ikifuta siku kumi na moja. Historia ya kawaida inasema mashambulizi yalifanywa juu yake. Hakuna rekodi ya wakati wowote ya uasi wowote inayobaki. Hadithi inatoka kwa bango katika picha ya uchaguzi wa 1755.
gregorian-1752-eleven-days.coda: Kifaa kutoka picha kilikuwa rekodi ya tukio lisilo na alama nyingine.

bootstrap-the-impossible-joke.title: Kulipwa Kutoka Kwenye Kazi Isiwezekanayo
bootstrap-the-impossible-joke.body: "Kujilaza kwa kutumia vifaa vya miguu" inatoka kwa hadithi ya Baron Munchausen ya 1785 na ilitumika kupitia karne ya 19 kama mfano wa kawaida wa uwezekano wa kifizikia. Mwaka 1953, kompyuta ilikuja neno hili kwa mnyororo wa maagizo unaopata mashine kuanza yenyewe.
bootstrap-the-impossible-joke.coda: Neno la mchezo, kwa matumizi yake ya kwanza, ilikuwa punchline juu ya kushindwa kwa mchezo.

french-revolutionary-decimal-time.title: Saa Kumi za Siku
french-revolutionary-decimal-time.body: Mwaka 1793 Ufaransa iligawanya siku katika saa kumi za dakika kumi za desimali kila moja. Matumizi ya lazima yalianza Septemba 1794 na yalikuwa yamefutwa miezi saba baadaye. Uso wa desimali kwenye saa ya Palace ya Tuileries ulikuwa ukiendelea angalau hadi 1801.
french-revolutionary-decimal-time.coda: Mfumo uliofutwa ulikuwa umewekwa kwenye ukuta wa palace kwa miaka baadaye.

railway-time-gwr.title: Muda wa Treni Zilizoendelea
railway-time-gwr.body: Mwaka 1840, Great Western Railway ilitumia saa ya Greenwich kote mtandao wake, ikibadilisha saa ya kila mji. Mwaka 1855, takriban asilimia 98 ya miji ya Uingereza ilikuwa imefuata. Bunge halikuifanya kiwango cha taifa cha kisheria hadi 1880.
railway-time-gwr.coda: Saa ziliwakiliana juu ya muda miaka kumi na nne kabla ya sheria.

western-union-telephone-memo-1876.title: Barua Western Union Haiandikiwi
western-union-telephone-memo-1876.body: Barua ya 1876 ya Western Union inayohusishwa sana inaita simu "idiotic" ikilinganishwa na kutuma mpelelezi ofisini ya telegramu. Watafiti wanaochunguza vyombo vya habari vya kipindi hicho hawakupata uhusiano wowote wa barua hiyo, na mkuu anayejulikana katika barua hiyo hakuhudumu katika nafasi hiyo kampuni mwaka huo. Maudhui yalifanywa baadaye.
western-union-telephone-memo-1876.coda: Western Union ilikataa patenti ya Bell mwaka huo; ilikuwa haiandiki barua hii.

nintendo-hanafuda-detours.title: Migeu Baada ya Kadi za Maua
nintendo-hanafuda-detours.body: Fusajiro Yamauchi alifungua duka Kyoto mwaka 1889 akifanya kadi za hanafuda kwa mkono. Kampuni baadaye ilijaribu huduma ya taksi na mchanga wa haraka, zote zikachukuliwa; daawa inayorudiwa sana ya mnyororo wa hoteli za upendo haina rekodi katika ratibu za hisa zilizochunguzwa hadi 1962.
nintendo-hanafuda-detours.coda: Mwaka 1966 chombo kilichoitwa Ultra Hand kilikuza mauzo ya mamia ya maelfu ya vifurushi.

wrigley-premiums-premium.title: Tuzo ya Tuzo
wrigley-premiums-premium.body: Mwaka 1891 William Wrigley Jr. aliuza sabuni Chicago na akatoa baking powder kama tuzo. Wateja walitaka baking powder zaidi kuliko sabuni, hivyo akabadilisha kuuaia baking powder badala yake, na kuongeza gumu ya kunywa kama tuzo ya baking powder yenyewe. Wateja walitaka gumu zaidi.
wrigley-premiums-premium.coda: Kwa 1892 alikuwa amechukua sabuni na baking powder kuuaia gumu peke yake.

robot-labor-not-brother.title: Mwenye Kuunda Roboti Bila Kuthibitishwa
robot-labor-not-brother.body: Karel Čapek alikuandaa mchezo wa 1920 kwa neno la Kilatini, "laboři," na akadhani ni la kitabu sana. Katika kiti cha gazeti alijulisha chanzo halisi: kaka yake Josef, aliyetoa kwa upole. "Robot" inatoka robota — kazi ya dharura ya mkulima, si mashine.
robot-labor-not-brother.coda: Mchezo ulibaki na jina la kaka mmoja ukurasa wa kwanza.

play-doh-wallpaper-cleaner.title: Ilikuwa Imebuniwa Kusafisha Kadi za Ukuta
play-doh-wallpaper-cleaner.body: Katika miaka ya 1930, Kutol ilitengeneza mchanga laini kusafisha moshi wa mawe ya mawe kutoka kadi za ukuta. Mara nyumba zikabadilisha mafuta ya joto safi, mahitaji yalipotea. Mwalimu alipendekeza kuuaia kama mchanga wa kuunda; ilibadilishwa jina Play-Doh mwaka 1956.
play-doh-wallpaper-cleaner.coda: Kwa 2005 ilikuwa inauza bidhaa 95 milioni kwa mwaka katika nchi 75.

hedy-lamarr-frequency-hopping-patent.title: Patenti Walioifunika
hedy-lamarr-frequency-hopping-patent.body: Mnamo 1942, Lamarr na mwanamuziki George Antheil walipata patenti ya mfumo wa kukimbia masafa ili radio ya torpedo isiingiliwe. Jeshi la Bahari lilikuifanya siri, kuifunika, na kumshauri Lamarr kuuzia vibali vya vita badala yake. Patenti ilikufa mnamo 1959, kabla ya meli yoyote kuipanda.
hedy-lamarr-frequency-hopping-patent.coda: Lamarr hakupokea malipo ya patenti katika maisha yake.

bush-1945-memex.title: Meza Isiyojengwa
bush-1945-memex.body: Mnamo Julai 1945, Vannevar Bush alichapisha "As We May Think" katika The Atlantic, akieleza mashine ya filamu ndogo ya ukubwa wa meza inayoitwa Memex ambayo iliruhusu mtumiaji kujenga njia za mawasiliano kupitia maarifa yaliyohifadhiwa. Ilisomwa tena katika chapisho fupi mnamo Septemba. Hakuna prototipi iliyojengwa kamwe.
bush-1945-memex.coda: Engelbart na Nelson wote baadaye walimshukuru maandishi kama sababu ya kuanza.

jean-bartik-eniac-dinner.title: Chakula Kilichowashirikiwa
jean-bartik-eniac-dinner.body: Katika ufunguzi wa umma wa ENIAC tarehe 14 Februari 1946, programu ya mwelekeo iliyowashangaza chumba ilikuwa imeandikwa na Jean Bartik na Betty Holberton. Vyombo vya habari vilikuwa vikiangalia Eckert na Mauchly tu. Hakuna mmoja wa wanawake sita wa programu aliyehudhuria chakula baada ya hapo.
jean-bartik-eniac-dinner.coda: Majina yao yalirudishwa kutoka picha za matukio miaka mingi baadaye.

claude-shannon-juggling-theorem.title: Nadharia ya Kucheza Mpira
claude-shannon-juggling-theorem.body: Mnamo 1948, Shannon alichapisha 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication,' akianzisha nadharia ya habari. Miaka mingi baadaye aligeuza ukali huo huo kwenye shughuli yake, akitoa uhusiano rasmi kati ya muda wa upepo wa mpira, muda wa kukaa, na idadi ya mipira na mikono.
claude-shannon-juggling-theorem.coda: Iliokusanywa katika kitabu kimoja na karatasi ya 1948.

mccarthy-1960-eval.title: Mtafsiri katika Kumbukumbu
mccarthy-1960-eval.body: Katika karatasi yake ya 1960, John McCarthy aliandika kazi ya eval kama alama za hisabati, ili kuonyesha kuwa usemi wa alama unaweza kuelezea mwenyewe. Mwanafunzi wake Steve Russell alitafsiri utokaji huo kuwa msimbo wa mashine wa IBM 704. Kifaa cha ushahidi kilikuwa mtafsiri wa kwanza wa Lisp unaofanya kazi.
mccarthy-1960-eval.coda: McCarthy baadaye alisema hakukusudia mtu yeyote kuifanya kazi kweli.

licklider-1960-symbiosis.title: Maktaba Zimeunganishwa Pamoja
licklider-1960-symbiosis.body: Katika karatasi yake ya 1960 "Man-Computer Symbiosis," J.C.R. Licklider alitoa wazo la "thinking centers" zinazoshikilia kazi za maktaba, zikiunganishwa katika mtandao kwa matumizi ya kompyuta kwa muda halisi na kwa mjadala. Mashine nyingi za siku hiyo zilikuwa zikifanya kazi kwa kadi za picha kwa pakiti; viungo vya mwingiliano vilikuwa vikiwepo kidogo sana.
licklider-1960-symbiosis.coda: Miaka miwili baadaye alisimamia ofisi mpya ya Pentagon na kufadhili mradi uliokuwa ARPANET.

ctss-1962-password-leak.title: Faili ya Neno la Siri, Iliyochapishwa
ctss-1962-password-leak.body: Mnamo 1962, mwanafunzi wa PhD wa MIT Allan Scherr alikuwa amekataa saa nne kwa wiki alizopita kwenye CTSS. Aligundua amri ya kuchapisha nje ya mtandao ilikuwa inaweza kuchukua faili za akaunti yoyote, kwa hivyo alichapisha UACCNT.SECRET, faili iliyoshikilia neno la siri lote, na kushiriki ili kukopa akaunti na kuendelea kufanya uchunguzi wake.
ctss-1962-password-leak.coda: Scherr hakutambua kwa mkuu wa maabara hadi karibia miaka thelathini baadaye.

katherine-johnson-check-the-numbers.title: Wacheze Kijana Ahesabu Tena
katherine-johnson-check-the-numbers.body: Kabla ya upepo wake wa 1962, John Glenn alikuwa na wahandisi wamwulize Katherine Johnson kuhesabu tena kwa mkono njia IBM 7090 tayari ilikuwa imehesabu. 'Ikiwa anasema ni nzuri,' alisema, 'nimeandaa kwenda.' Nambari zake ziligana na za kompyuta kabisa.

daemon-backronym.title: Akronimu ya Daemon Iliyowekwa Baadaye
daemon-backronym.body: Mwaka 1963, wafanyikazi wa Mradi MAC wa MIT walimwita mchakato wa kufunga nyuma wa tape kwa jina la demon ya Maxwell, wakala wa jaribio la kufikiri la 1867 unaopanga molekuli bila kuyeka na bila kuonekana — daimon ya Kigiriki, roho ya kati, si ibilisi ya Kiyahudi-Kikristo.
daemon-backronym.coda: "Disk And Execution MONitor" iliwekwa juu ya neno baadaye.

sketchpad-1963.title: Kalamu ya Mwanga na Oscilloscope
sketchpad-1963.body: Mwezi Januari 1963, Ivan Sutherland alitoa teshi yake ya MIT juu ya Sketchpad, akipiga picha ya jiometri iliyokamilika kwa kalamu ya mwanga kwenye skrini ya TX-2 ya Lincoln Laboratory. Mashine ilikosa takriban dola milioni moja na chache zilizopo; ubao wake wa kuchora haukuweza kupelekwa kwa mtu yeyote mwingine.
sketchpad-1963.coda: Programu za CAD za biashara zilikataa karibu miaka ishirini kufanana na kile teshi ilikuwa imeonyesha.

douglas-mcilroy-garden-hose-pipe.title: Barua ya Mafuriko ya Bustani
douglas-mcilroy-garden-hose-pipe.body: Mwaka 1964, McIlroy alikuandikia Barua ya Bell Labs akipendekeza programu zisimamane kama mafuriko ya bustani — uweke sehemu nyingine ili kubadilisha data. Iliendelea, ikapenda, na haikujengwa. Miaka tisa baadaye, Ken Thompson aliongeza herufi moja, |, kwenye Unix shell usiku mmoja.
douglas-mcilroy-garden-hose-pipe.coda: Asubuhi, programu ambazo hazikuongea pamoja ziliwafanya.

berkshire-hathaway-spite-buy.title: Mfuko Uliununuliwa kwa Hasira
berkshire-hathaway-spite-buy.body: Mwaka 1964 Warren Buffett alikubali kwa kauli kuuzia hisa zake kwa rais wa Berkshire, Seabury Stanton, kwa $11.50 kila moja. Ofa ya kuuzia ilikuja kwa $11.375. Buffett alikuwa na hasira sana juu ya sehemu iliyokosekana kwamba alinunua udhibiti wa kampuni badala na kuifukuza Stanton.
berkshire-hathaway-spite-buy.coda: Mwaka 1985 alifunga viwanda vya utengenezaji vya kamba ambavyo alikuwa amekabiliwa kuweka.

nelson-1965-hypertext.title: Kiungo Kabla ya Ukurasa
nelson-1965-hypertext.body: Katika makala ya ACM ya 1965, Ted Nelson alitengeneza neno 'hypertext' kwa hati zinazounganisha na kutaja kila moja kwa mfululizo usiofuata, zikijenga juu ya mradi alioanza mwaka 1960 na baadaye aliupe jina Xanadu. Toleo lake lilitoa malipo kwa waandishi wa asili kwa kila kiungo kilichofuatiwa. Utekelezaji wa sehemu haukuwasilishwa hadi 2014.
nelson-1965-hypertext.coda: Mtandao ulichukua lugha yake na kuacha mfumo wa malipo nyuma.

mary-allen-wilkes-linc.title: LINC katika Chumba cha Maisha
mary-allen-wilkes-linc.body: Mwaka 1965, Wilkes alisogeza kompyuta ya LINC yenye uzito wa 250 pauni kwenye chumba cha maisha cha wazazi wake Baltimore na kuandika LAP6, mfumo wa uendeshaji wa kuingiliana, peke yake — miaka kumi na mbili kabla ya Apple II kufika nyumba yoyote. Alipoulizwa kama alikuwa wa kwanza, alisema tu: 'Nadhani nikuwa nimekuwa.'
mary-allen-wilkes-linc.coda: Hakuna aliyedai kichwa hicho kwa ujasiri mwenyewe.

hoares-billion-dollar-mistake.title: Marejeleo Aliyoongeza Hata hivyo
hoares-billion-dollar-mistake.body: Mwaka 1965 Tony Hoare alikuwa ajenzi mfumo wa kwanza wa aina uliokusudiwa kufanya marejeleo ya ALGOL W yasiwe salama wakati wa kuandaa. Aliongeza marejeleo ya sifuri hata hivyo, kwa sababu ilikuwa rahisi kutekeleza. Mwaka 2009 alisema ni kosa lake la dola bilioni.
hoares-billion-dollar-mistake.coda: Lengo la usalama lilikuwa wazi; kushindwa kilikuwa kwamba urahisi ulishinda hata hivyo.

johnson-vs-cern-touchscreen.title: Nani Alisema Kwanza
johnson-vs-cern-touchscreen.body: CERN inayomkubali Bent Stumpe kwa kujenga skrin ya kugusa ya kwanza ya umeme duniani mwaka 1972, kwa chumba cha kudhibiti accelerator yake. Eric Johnson wa Royal Radar Establishment ya Uingereza tayari alikuwa amechapisha makala juu ya teknolojia ya kugusa kwa kidole ya umeme mwaka 1965, miaka saba mapema.
johnson-vs-cern-touchscreen.coda: Dai la CERN la kujenga skrin ya kwanza ya kugusa bado linasimama kwenye tovuti yake mwenyewe.

second-redefined-1967.title: Mizunguko 9,192,631,770
second-redefined-1967.body: Hadi 1960, sekunde ilikuwa sehemu ya mwaka wa tropiki wa 1900, iliyobainishwa na uchunguzi wa astronomia. Mwaka 1967, Mkutano wa Jumuiya wa Mizani na Vipimo uliibadilisha tena kuwa mizunguko 9,192,631,770 ya mpito wa caesium-133.
second-redefined-1967.coda: Urefu wa sekunde ukasimama kuwekwa na jua na kuanza kuwekwa na atomi.

goto-statement-considered-harmful.title: Kichwa Ambacho Hakuchapishwa
goto-statement-considered-harmful.body: Dijkstra alituma makala iliyoketi A Case against the GO TO Statement kwa CACM. Mhariri Niklaus Wirth, ukisukuma kwa haraka kuchapishwa kama barua, ukampa kichwa kilichokifanya kuwa mashuhuri: Go To Statement Considered Harmful.
goto-statement-considered-harmful.coda: Neno lilipita barua, likizalisha miaka mingi ya mababu ya 'X Considered Harmful' ambayo hakuna mtu aliyosoma zaidi.

rollkugel-vs-mouse.title: Panya Mbili, Mwaka Mmoja
rollkugel-vs-mouse.body: Mwaka 1968, mwezi Oktoba, Telefunken ilirejesha panya ya Rollkugel katika brocha ya mauzo, kifaa cha mpira unaozunguka ambacho wahandisi wake walikuwa wamejenga tangu 1966. Miaka miwili baadaye, tarehe 9 Desemba, Douglas Engelbart alionyesha panya ya mbao timu yake ya SRI ilikuwa imejenga tangu 1963. Timu yoyote haikuwa na habari ya nyingine.
rollkugel-vs-mouse.coda: Telefunken ilifika sokoni kwanza na kusahauliwa; Engelbart alikuja pili na ndiyo maana ya panya.

peter-principle-verified.title: Kufundishwa kwa Ujuzi
peter-principle-verified.body: Mwaka 1969, Laurence Peter na Raymond Hull walinong'aa nusu katika bestseller kwamba kila mshirika anapanda hadi kiwango ambacho anakuwa hawezi kufanya kazi, iliyokusudiwa kama satire. Mwaka 2019, utafiti wa data ya kuandikishwa kwa nguvu za mauzo katika makampuni 214 halisi ulipata kwamba nong'ono ilikuwa sahihi: wauzaji bora walikuwa wazalishaji mbaya.
peter-principle-verified.coda: Nong'ono ilikuwa kizidisho cha regression kilichopimwa na kuchapishwa.

lanpar-vs-visicalc.title: Lahajedwali Ambalo Hakuna Aliyelitaja
lanpar-vs-visicalc.body: Katika majira ya joto ya 1969, wahitimu wa Harvard Rene Pardo na Remy Landau waliandika LANPAR, lugha ya lahajedwali iliyowaruhusu watumiaji kuingiza fomula kwa mpangilio wowote na bado kuhesabu kwa usahihi. Bell Canada na General Motors ziliitumia. Mnamo 1979, Dan Bricklin alijenga VisiCalc bila kujua kwamba LANPAR ilikuwepo.
lanpar-vs-visicalc.coda: Hati miliki ya LANPAR ilinusurika changamoto ya mahakama hadi 1983; majarida yalikuwa tayari yamemtaja VisiCalc kwanza.

spam-vikings-not-marketers.title: Spam, Kabla ya Masoko
spam-vikings-not-marketers.body: Katika kipande cha 1970, Vikings wa Monty Python waliimba "spam" juu ya mazungumzo ya mlo, wakidhihaki wingi wa nyama ya makopo kwenye menyu. Utani huo ulihamia kwenye vyumba vya mazungumzo vya MUD mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1980 kwa ajili ya kufurika kwa mazungumzo, kisha kwenye barua pepe mapema miaka ya 1990.
spam-vikings-not-marketers.coda: Neno hilo lilifika kwenye sanduku za barua kwa njia ya kipande cha ucheshi kuhusu chakula cha mchana.

codd-1970-relational-model.title: Waraka Ambao Mwajiri Wake Aliupuuza
codd-1970-relational-model.body: Mnamo 1970, mtafiti wa IBM Edgar Codd alichapisha mfano wa uhusiano. Bidhaa kuu ya IBM ilikuwa ya daraja, na kampuni haikuwa na haraka ya kupitisha wazo lake. Larry Ellison alisoma waraka wa Codd na ripoti za System R za IBM yenyewe, kisha akasafirisha bidhaa ya kibiashara ya hifadhidata ya uhusiano kwanza, mnamo 1979.
codd-1970-relational-model.coda: Bidhaa ya uhusiano ya IBM yenyewe, DB2, haikusafirishwa hadi 1983.

linnainmaa-backpropagation.title: Rejea Iliyokosekana
linnainmaa-backpropagation.body: Mnamo 1970, mwanafunzi wa Kifini Seppo Linnainmaa alichapisha algorithm kamili ya upambanuzi wa kiotomatiki wa mwelekeo wa nyuma, pamoja na msimbo unaofanya kazi, katika tasnifu yake ya uzamili. Mnamo 1986, Rumelhart, Hinton na Williams walichapisha njia hiyo hiyo katika Nature kufundisha mitandao ya neva. Hawakumrejea.
linnainmaa-backpropagation.coda: Tasnifu ya Linnainmaa ilikaa bila rejea kwa miaka kumi na sita kabla ya wanahistoria wa uwanja huo kuichimba tena.

at-sign-arbitrary-pick.title: Kitufe Pekee Kisichotumika
at-sign-arbitrary-pick.body: Mnamo 1971, mhandisi wa BBN Ray Tomlinson alihitaji kitenganishi kati ya jina la mtumiaji na seva ambacho hakingeweza kamwe kuonekana katika jina halisi la mtu. Akichunguza kibodi yake ya Model 33 Teletype, alichagua @ — herufi iliyokuwa ikitumika karibu tu na wauzaji wa mboga na wahesabuji.
at-sign-arbitrary-pick.coda: Kila anwani ya barua pepe tangu wakati huo imebeba kizuizi hicho kimoja mbele.

parnas-module-decomposition.title: Mahali pa Kukata Moduli
parnas-module-decomposition.body: Mnamo 1972 David Parnas akagawanya mfumo huo huo wa KWIC-index katika moduli kwa njia mbili: moja kwa hatua ya usindikaji, nyingine kwa maamuzi ya muundo yanayoweza kubadilika zaidi, kila moja ikifichwa nyuma ya kiolesura. Njia ya pili peke yake iliruhusu mabadiliko kuugua moduli moja bila mtu yeyote kusoma baki.
parnas-module-decomposition.coda: Mpaka wa moduli ukagundulika kuwa unasimulia dhana juu ya kile msimamizi wa baadaye angehitaji kujua.

karen-sparck-jones-idf.title: Fomula Hesi Asiyeshukuruwa
karen-sparck-jones-idf.body: Mnamo 1992, Spärck Jones alichapisha makala ikapendekeza kuwa utupu wa neno katika mkusanyiko wa hati unapima umuhimu wake — mzunguko wa marudio ya hati, sasa chini ya mantiki ya upangilio wa injini zote karibu za utafutaji. Hakupata kazi ya kudumu Cambridge hadi 1993.
karen-sparck-jones-idf.coda: Hadi wakati huo alikuwa amefanya mfululizo wa mikataba ya muda mfupi, fedha dhaifu.

cyclades-pouzin-tcpip.title: Mtu wa Tano wa Mtandao
cyclades-pouzin-tcpip.body: Mnamo 1972, Louis Pouzin aliunda mtandao wa CYCLADES Ufaransa, wa kwanza kuweka majukumu ya utoaji wa kuaminika kwa mabaa ya mwisho, si mtandao. Mnamo 1974, makala ya TCP ya Cerf na Kahn ilimshukuru kwa jina. Mnamo 2004, Cerf na Kahn walishinda Tuzo ya Turing. Jina la Pouzin halikuwa juu yake.
cyclades-pouzin-tcpip.coda: The Economist baadaye ilimuita mtu wa tano wa mtandao.

ethernet-1973-memo.title: Barua ya Ether
ethernet-1973-memo.body: Tarehe 22 Mei 1973, Robert Metcalfe aliandika barua ya Xerox PARC iliyopewa kichwa "Ether Acquisition," na mchoro wa mkono wa kebo ya pamoja inayounganisha kompyuta za Alto. Teknolojia hii kwa kawaida inatolewa tarehe ya makala ya jarida ya 1976. Mchoro halisi ni wa miaka mitatu zamzima, na wa mkono.
ethernet-1973-memo.coda: Kwa wakati makala ilichapishwa, Ethernet tayari ilikuwa imefanya kazi ndani ya PARC kwa miaka mitatu.

vint-cerf-envelope-sketch.title: Nyuma ya Barua
vint-cerf-envelope-sketch.body: Hadithi ya kuanzishwa kwa mtandao inasema Cerf alichora muundo wa lango kwenye kisu. Amerekebisha hili: 'Sikuwa ni kisu, kweli, ilikuwa nyuma ya barua.' Mnamo 1973, akitazama katika ukumbi wa hoteli, alichora kile kilichokuwa muundo wa lango la TCP/IP.
vint-cerf-envelope-sketch.coda: Mwaka uliofuata, mchoro ulikuwa makala katika IEEE Transactions on Communications.

gchq-nonsecret-encryption.title: Ufunguo Usiokuwa Uchapishwa
gchq-nonsecret-encryption.body: Mwaka 1973, mnamna wa miaka 22 Clifford Cocks, aliyefika hivi karibuni GCHQ, alitengeneza mpango wa usimbaji usio na ufunguo wa pamoja kwa nusu ya saa. Miaka mitatu baadaye, Diffie, Hellman na Merkle walichapisha wazo hili huko Marekani na walitajwa kama wachangiaji wake. Hati za GCHQ ziliendelea kuwa siri hadi 1997.
gchq-nonsecret-encryption.coda: James Ellis alikufa mwaka 1997, miezi michache baada ya ufunuo ulioweka jina lake kwenye rekodi.

kodak-digital-camera-1975.title: Kamera Iliyofichwa ya Kodak
kodak-digital-camera-1975.body: Mwaka 1975, mhandisi Steven Sasson wa miaka 24 alijenga kamera ya kwanza ya kidijitali: kilo 8, sekunde 23 kwa picha moja. Wakuu walifikiria hakuna mtu angependa kuangalia picha kwenye televisheni wakati chapisho kilikuwa bei nafuu na kimefanya kazi kwa karne moja. Walitafuta patenti ya kamera na kuweka kando.
kodak-digital-camera-1975.coda: Kodak ilitafuta ulinzi wa uovu wa fedha mwaka 2012.

galls-law-origin.title: Kitabu Kuhusu Burokrasia
galls-law-origin.body: Mwaka 1975, baada ya wachapishaji 30 kukataa, daktari wa watoto John Gall alichapisha mwenyewe Systemantics: mfumo changamano unaofanya kazi unakuwa daima kutoka mfumo rahisi unaofanya kazi, na mfumo changamano uliojengwa kutoka sifuri haufanyi kazi. Alikuwa akitazama hospitali na taasisi za serikali.
galls-law-origin.coda: Wabunifu wa programu walibaki na mstari na kuondoa polepole burokrasia ambazo ziliandikwa kuhusu.

ken-olsen-home-computer-1977.title: Kompyuta ya Nyumbani ya Olsen
ken-olsen-home-computer-1977.body: Mwaka 1977, mwenzi wa DEC Ken Olsen alisema hakuna sababu ya mtu kuwa na kompyuta nyumbani. Alimaanisha mashine moja ya kati inayofanya kazi kwa mwanga, joto na burudani ya nyumba, sahihi kwa kitu alichotoa. Ripoti ilibaki na nusu ya kwanza ya sentensi.
ken-olsen-home-computer-1977.coda: Olsen mwenyewe alikuwa na kompyuta nyumbani wakati huo.

kernighans-debugging-law.title: Marudio Mawili Kuliko Kuandika
kernighans-debugging-law.body: Katika Elements of Programming Style ya 1978, Kernighan na Plauger walikuwa wameandika kuwa debugging ni ngumu mara mbili kuliko kuandika programu, kwa hivyo kuandika kwa akili unaweza kufanya kazi, kwa ufafanuzi, haukuwa na akili ya kutosha kufanya debugging. Kanuni ya mtindo iliyotajwa kama kikomo cha kukutana na kazi yako mara mbili.
kernighans-debugging-law.coda: Adversary hakukuwa mtu mwingine, ilikuwa wewe baada ya wiki chache.

xerox-parc-1979-visit.title: Mkataba wa Xerox Mwenyewe
xerox-parc-1979-visit.body: Desemba 1979: Apple ilitembelea Xerox PARC baada ya Xerox kukubali kununua hisa 100,000 za Apple kabla ya IPO kwa $10 kila moja kwa upatikanaji huo. Jobs aliona kiolesura cha picha cha Alto na kuuita kitu bora alichokiona kamwe. Hadithi inayojulikana ni uchochezi; rekodi ni biashara Xerox iliyokubaliana.
xerox-parc-1979-visit.coda: Xerox ilipata hisa zake. Alto hakujawauzwa kama bidhaa ya biashara.

visicalc-1979-no-patent.title: Patenti Walioipuuza
visicalc-1979-no-patent.body: Kabla ya toleo la VisiCalc la 1979, Dan Bricklin aliuliza mwanasheria wa patenti, ambaye alikuweka nafasi ya mafanikio takribani moja kati ya kumi chini ya sheria za wakati huo. Walituma ombi la haki za kipekee na alama ya biashara badala yake. Mwaka 1983, Lotus 1-2-3 ilitoa kiolesura kinachofaa ambacho kilisoma faili za VisiCalc mwenyewe.
visicalc-1979-no-patent.coda: Chati ilikaliwa kama kategoria. Kampuni iliyoyatengeneza haikuwa.

ibm-microsoft-dos-1980.title: IBM Inaacha Mlango Ufunguli
ibm-microsoft-dos-1980.body: IBM ilisaini na Microsoft juu ya mfumo wa uendeshaji wa PC tarehe 6 Novemba, 1980. Ndani ya kesi ya anti-monopoly ya zaidi ya miaka kumi, IBM ilichagua kutokuwa na udhibiti wa watoa huduma zake, na kuwezesha Microsoft kuuzia DOS kwa mtu yeyote mwingine. Kama ulinzi dhidi ya kesi nyingine, ilikuwa na maana wakati huo.
ibm-microsoft-dos-1980.coda: Wafanyaji wa nakala wafuata ndani ya miaka, na IBM haikupata tena udhibiti wa jukwaa.

postel-law-robustness-reversal.title: Kanuni ya Uimara, Kinyume
postel-law-robustness-reversal.body: RFC 761 (1980) ilimshauri watekelezaji kuwa wazalendo katika kile wanachokubali, wazalendo katika kile wanachotuma. Mwaka 2023 bodi ya miundo ya IETF mwenyewe iligeuza mwongozo huo katika RFC 9413: huruma inaruhusu hitilafu kukauka kuwa viwango vya de facto, ikiwaacha mifumo ikiwa na uimara mdogo, si mwingi.
postel-law-robustness-reversal.coda: Kiwango kilichomwambia mtandao kuwa huruma kilikataliwa na walinzi wake mwenyewe.

end-to-end-argument.title: Hujji kwa Mtandao Dhaifu
end-to-end-argument.body: Mwaka 1981 Saltzer, Reed, na Clark walidai kuwa ukaguzi wa faili inayohamishiwa kwa hitilafu unaweza kufanywa kwa usahihi tu katika ncha mbili; mtandao unaweza kusaidia lakini hauwezi kubadilisha kabisa. Karatasi juu ya mahali pa kuweka checksum ilikuwa kesi ya kuanzisha ya kuweka mitandao rahisi.
end-to-end-argument.coda: Ukumbusho juu ya mahali pa ukaguzi wa hitilafu ulikua kuwa kesi ya haki sawa ya mtandao.

excel-1900-leap-year.title: Mwaka wa Kuzaliwa Usiku Usiku Usiku Usiku
excel-1900-leap-year.body: Lotus 1-2-3 ilichukulia 1900 kama mwaka wa kuzaliwa, njia rahisi isiyo na hatari. Microsoft ikopisha tarehe uongo huo ili kuendelea kuwa na ubadilishaji. Lotus imepotea; siku uongo ya kuzaliwa inabaki, sasa imeandikwa katika maagizo ya Office Open XML.
excel-1900-leap-year.coda: Njia ya ubadilishaji kwa mpinzani aliyefutwa sasa ni kiwango kilichowekwa.

avatar-before-snow-crash.title: Avatar Kabla ya Hadithi
avatar-before-snow-crash.body: Hadithi ya Neal Stephenson ya 1992 Snow Crash kwa kawaida inapewa heshima kwa maana ya mtandaoni ya "avatar." Lakini Habitat ya Lucasfilm, iliyokuwa ikifanya kazi kwenye Commodore 64 tangu 1985, tayari ilikuwa imeandika: "wacheza wanawakilishwa na mashimo ya kuishi ambayo tunaita Avatars," kutoka Kisanaskiti kwa maana ya kuzaa tena.
avatar-before-snow-crash.coda: Neno lilikuwa hai kwenye huduma ya biashara miaka saba kabla ya kitabu.

radia-perlman-algorhyme.title: Algorhyme
radia-perlman-algorhyme.body: Mwaka 1985, meneja wa Perlman katika DEC alitoa tatizo la kuunganisha bila mzunguko Alhamisi, kisha alipotea kwa wiki moja. Alikamilisha algoriti ya mti wa kuenea Ijumaa — na alitumia baada yake kuandika Algorhyme, mashairi ambayo yalikuwa muhtasari wa karatasi.
radia-perlman-algorhyme.coda: Shairi lilichukua muda mrefu kuandika kuliko algorithm.

brooks-no-silver-bullet.title: Hakuna Risasi ya Fedha
brooks-no-silver-bullet.body: Katika kongamano la IFIP la 1986, Fred Brooks aligawanya ugumu wa programu kuwa wa asili na wa ajali. Ugumu wa ajali ulikuwa umepungua sana, alisema, lakini hakuna mbinu moja ambayo ingeweza kuleta ongezeko la tija mara kumi ndani ya muongo mmoja.
brooks-no-silver-bullet.coda: Miongo minne baadaye, kila dhana mpya bado inauzwa kama risasi aliyosema haipo.

tz-olson-database.title: Hifadhidata ya Olson
tz-olson-database.body: Vifaa vingi hutatua maeneo ya saa dhidi ya seti moja ya faili inayoendeshwa na wataalamu wa kujitolea, inayojulikana kwa jina la Hifadhidata ya Olson baada ya mwanzilishi Arthur David Olson. Mpango wake wa upeanaji majina unatambuliwa kwa Paul Eggert, ambaye kwa hakida amekuwa akitunza hifadhidata tangu 2005.
tz-olson-database.coda: Mtu anayetajwa na jina lake na mtu aliyeitunza tangu wakati huo ni watu tofauti.

china-1987-first-email.title: Beyond the Wall
china-1987-first-email.body: Retellings credit Qian Tianbai alone with China's first email, 'Across the Great Wall we can reach every corner of the world.' Qian was studying in the US that month; it was typed by Li Chengjiong and Karlsruhe's Werner Zorn, and left China six days later, on September 20.
china-1987-first-email.coda: His obituaries still list him as the sender.

barbara-liskov-substitution-property.title: The Law She Never Named
barbara-liskov-substitution-property.body: In a 1987 OOPSLA keynote, Barbara Liskov proposed that if substituting an object of type S for type T left every program's behavior unchanged, S was a subtype of T. She called it a substitution property. Years later, Robert Martin folded it into SOLID and named it after her.
barbara-liskov-substitution-property.coda: The word 'principle' was someone else's addition.

go-corporation-pen-computing.title: The Tablet Nobody Bought
go-corporation-pen-computing.body: In 1987 Jerry Kaplan started GO Corporation to build the pen-based PenPoint operating system, raising $75 million. AT&T acquired GO in January 1994, cancelled its supporting chip line two weeks later, and GO closed that July. Kaplan later said the company had "no meaningful sales."
go-corporation-pen-computing.coda: In 2010 Apple released the iPad, a capacitive multitouch tablet.

iso8601-unify-then-fork.title: ISO 8601's Narrower Stand-in
iso8601-unify-then-fork.body: ISO 8601 was first published in 1988, unifying five earlier, conflicting ISO date-and-time standards into one. But the format most internet software validates against is RFC 3339 (1997), a narrower profile that, after ISO 8601's later revision, is not even a strict subset of it.
iso8601-unify-then-fork.coda: The standard everyone cites and the dialect everyone's code checks against are not the same document.

python-christmas-project.title: A Christmas Hobby
python-christmas-project.body: During the Christmas holidays of 1989, with his office closed for the week, a researcher in Amsterdam looked for a hobby programming project. He began writing an interpreter for a new scripting language and named it after a comedy troupe, not the snake.
python-christmas-project.coda: In July 2026 it ranked first on the TIOBE index of programming language popularity.

worse-is-better.title: Worse Is Better
worse-is-better.body: In 1989 Richard Gabriel coined 'worse is better': a simple, half-right implementation survives better than a complete, correct one, which is why he thought C and Unix beat Lisp. In 1991 he published a rebuttal under the pseudonym Nickieben Bourbaki, posing as an old friend.
worse-is-better.coda: Decades later he still said he could not decide whether his own argument was right.

rfc1149-avian-carriers-test.title: The Protocol Someone Actually Flew
rfc1149-avian-carriers-test.body: David Waitzman published RFC 1149 on April Fools' Day, 1990: a spec for carrying IP datagrams by pigeon. On April 28, 2001, the Bergen Linux User Group actually built it, launching nine ping packets over roughly 5 km. Four came back — a 55% loss rate, round trips running 53 to 106 minutes.
rfc1149-avian-carriers-test.coda: The joke RFC has a real packet-loss figure on record: 55 percent.

att-1990-break-statement.title: The Misplaced Break
att-1990-break-statement.body: A recovery routine on a New York 4ESS switch held a break statement nested one level too shallow, a defect testing never exercised. A restart's routine "ready" signal was then misread by neighboring switches as an error, and the false alarm cascaded through the network for nine hours.
att-1990-break-statement.coda: AT&T later put the lost revenue at sixty million dollars.

aspec-vs-musicam.title: Losing to the Simpler One
aspec-vs-musicam.body: In 1991, MPEG tested two rival audio codecs. ASPEC, built by Fraunhofer, AT&T and France's CNET, won the quality tests but was ruled too complex. MUSICAM, from Matsushita and Philips, won on simplicity. The finished MP3 folded ASPEC's filter design back in anyway.
aspec-vs-musicam.coda: The format everyone calls MP3 carries the losing proposal's engineering inside the winning one's name.

linux-minix-post.title: A Post to comp.os.minix
linux-minix-post.body: On August 25, 1991, a Helsinki university student posted to the comp.os.minix newsgroup that he was writing a free operating system, calling it "just a hobby, won't be big and professional like gnu," and asked what features people wanted.
linux-minix-post.coda: Since November 2017, all 500 of the world's fastest supercomputers have run an OS built on it.

web-vs-gopher-1991.title: Free Beat Priced
web-vs-gopher-1991.body: In 1991, Tim Berners-Lee released the World Wide Web from CERN. That same year, the University of Minnesota released Gopher, for a time the more popular system. In February 1993, Minnesota announced licensing fees for Gopher servers. That April, CERN made the web protocol free.
web-vs-gopher-1991.coda: Gopher had the bigger following before the fee announcement, and never had it again afterward.

rough-consensus-running-code.title: Rough Consensus, Running Code
rough-consensus-running-code.body: At the July 1992 IETF meeting, MIT's Dave Clark put up a slide: 'We reject kings, presidents and voting. We believe in rough consensus and running code.' The phrase now anchors internet-governance folklore. It began as a jab at OSI's formal committee voting process.
rough-consensus-running-code.coda: The joke slide about OSI's voting rules became internet governance's founding creed.

han-unification-japanese-delegate.title: Han Unification's Unlikely Author
han-unification-japanese-delegate.body: In 1992 the CJK Joint Research Group merged tens of thousands of Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters into shared Unicode code points. Popular retellings cast Japan as the objector. Unicode's own history credits the verification rules to Japanese delegate Miyazawa Akira.
han-unification-japanese-delegate.coda: The delegation cast as the victim helped write the rules it is remembered for opposing.

china-first-internet-line.title: The Line a Year Early
china-first-internet-line.body: China marks April 20, 1994 as the day it joined the global internet — a 64K line, full-function access. Thirteen months earlier, physicists at IHEP had already leased a line to Stanford's SLAC, exchanging email with dozens of institutions. It just wasn't the kind of line anyone counted.
china-first-internet-line.coda: Two lines exist; only one gets an anniversary.

wiki-the-airport-shuttle.title: Named After a Shuttle Bus
wiki-the-airport-shuttle.body: "Wiki" is Hawaiian for "quick." In 1995, Ward Cunningham needed a name for the first editable web system he built and reached not for any technical term but for his memory of the Wiki Wiki Shuttle, the free bus between terminals at Honolulu's airport.
wiki-the-airport-shuttle.coda: The word's first home was painted on the side of an airport bus.

robots-exclusion-rfc9309.title: robots.txt: 28 Years Unratified
robots-exclusion-rfc9309.body: Martijn Koster proposed robots.txt in 1994; crawlers followed it voluntarily, with no formal standard and nothing to enforce it. Google proposed standardization in 2019, and the IETF finally published RFC 9309 in September 2022, closing a 28-year gap.
robots-exclusion-rfc9309.coda: The web's most-obeyed gentleman's agreement took twenty-eight years to become a real standard.

pentium-fdiv-writeoff.title: The Missing Table Entries
pentium-fdiv-writeoff.body: Mathematician Thomas Nicely noticed his new Pentium returning slightly wrong results while summing reciprocals of primes, and traced the fault to the chip itself. Intel first offered replacements only to customers who complained, and reversed into a full recall only under public pressure.
pentium-fdiv-writeoff.coda: Intel booked a $475 million pretax charge for the recall.

general-magic-private-network.title: General Magic's Private Wire
general-magic-private-network.body: In 1990 ex-Apple engineers Bill Atkinson, Andy Hertzfeld and Marc Porat founded General Magic. Sony's Magic Link shipped in 1994 for $800, sending email and running apps. Leadership built a proprietary AT&T network instead of using the internet, calling the web "passive."
general-magic-private-network.coda: Employee Tony Fadell later led hardware development on the iPod and iPhone at Apple.

ibm-simon-first-touchscreen.title: Simon's Fax Machine
ibm-simon-first-touchscreen.body: On August 16, 1994, IBM and BellSouth launched the Simon Personal Communicator: a 4.5-inch touchscreen that sent email and fax, priced at $899. Battery life ran about an hour. It was discontinued six months later, having sold roughly 50,000 units.
ibm-simon-first-touchscreen.coda: In 2007 Apple shipped the iPhone, a capacitive touchscreen phone with no physical keyboard.

cors-same-origin-orphaned.title: CORS: A Recommendation in Retirement
cors-same-origin-orphaned.body: Netscape bolted the same-origin policy onto Navigator in 1995, alongside JavaScript, with no standards process at all. CORS, meant to formally relax that policy, only became a W3C Recommendation in 2014 — and by 2020 the W3C had retired it, handing the spec to WHATWG's Fetch document.
cors-same-origin-orphaned.coda: The standards body retired its own security recommendation six years after publishing it.

php-resume-counter.title: A Résumé Hit Counter
php-resume-counter.body: In 1994, a programmer wrote a handful of small CGI programs in C for no larger reason than wanting to know how many people were looking at his online résumé. He called the toolkit "Personal Home Page Tools" and released the source in June 1995.
php-resume-counter.coda: Three decades on, over 70% of websites with a known server-side language still run its descendant.

craigslist-email-list.title: A Mailing List of Events
craigslist-email-list.body: In 1995, a software engineer in San Francisco started compiling the local gatherings and events he knew about into an email and sending it to a few friends, mainly so people could get to know one another a little better.
craigslist-email-list.coda: The list now reaches 570 cities in 70 countries and draws over 140 million visits a month.

wirths-law-misattributed.title: The Law He Credited Away
wirths-law-misattributed.body: In 1995 Niklaus Wirth published 'A Plea for Lean Software,' writing that software is getting slower more rapidly than hardware is getting faster. The line later christened Wirth's Law was, by his own footnote, a quotation of his colleague Martin Reiser.
wirths-law-misattributed.coda: The eponym cited the source; posterity kept only the eponym.

general-magic-weekend-site.title: The Site He Wasn't Serious About
general-magic-weekend-site.body: In the mid-1990s, at a Silicon Valley startup expected to reinvent handheld computing, one programmer spent his spare time writing a scrappy little site for selling secondhand junk. It went up on a weekend. He wasn't taking it seriously.
general-magic-weekend-site.coda: The startup was General Magic. The site was later renamed eBay.

gettickcount-776-day-bug.title: A 776-Day Debt
gettickcount-776-day-bug.body: Windows 95's GetTickCount rolls to zero every 49.7 days, documented behavior, never treated as a bug. But on Windows 8 through Server 2019, the same function could roll over early, near 776 days, a genuine defect. Microsoft fixed it only in Windows 11, version 24H2.
gettickcount-776-day-bug.coda: The fix landed three decades after the counter it patches first shipped.

bluetooth-the-placeholder.title: The Codename That Stuck
bluetooth-the-placeholder.body: In 1996, Intel's Jim Kardach proposed "Bluetooth" — after Harald Bluetooth, the Viking king who united Scandinavia — as a throwaway codename during Ericsson-Nokia talks. The intended replacement, RadioWire, could not clear trademark search before launch.
bluetooth-the-placeholder.coda: No replacement name ever made it to market.

chinaren-detour.title: The Off-Roster Coder
chinaren-detour.body: In 1996 a Chinese student won gold at the Informatics Olympiad and was admitted straight into Tsinghua's computer science program. As a student he moonlighted building a content system for an alumnus's website. Sohu bought it the next year; he stayed on and kept working there.
chinaren-detour.coda: The student was Wang Xiaochuan. In 2004, inside Sohu, he built Sogou.

google-a-typo.title: A Misspelled Domain Search
google-a-typo.body: During a September 1997 brainstorm, Sean Anderson suggested "googolplex"; Larry Page shortened it to "googol." Checking the domain registry on the spot, Anderson typed "google" by mistake and found it unclaimed. Page registered google.com that same day.
google-a-typo.coda: The registration record still carries the misspelling, dated September 15, 1997.

rfc2119-must-should.title: MUST vs must: A Twenty-Year Gap
rfc2119-must-should.body: RFC 2119 (March 1997) defined MUST, SHOULD, MAY and their negatives as binding requirement levels for IETF documents. But it only said these words 'are often capitalized' — lowercase must and should were never excluded. RFC 8174 patched the loophole in 2017: only all-caps counts.
rfc2119-must-should.coda: For twenty years, a lowercase must carried the same legal weight as a shrug.

netease-license-mail-1997.title: Sell the license first
netease-license-mail-1997.body: On June 11, 1997, William Ding registered NetEase in Guangzhou. The company's first business was not free webmail. It licensed a piece of email server software it had built to other websites for a fee.
netease-license-mail-1997.coda: NetEase did not launch its own free email, under 163.com, until 1998.

lixiang-graphics-card-home.title: Graphics Card Home
lixiang-graphics-card-home.body: In 1998, a high school student in Hebei started a personal website called Graphics Card Home in his spare time, posting reviews of computer graphics cards. Two years later he renamed it PCPop and kept updating it through the rest of school.
lixiang-graphics-card-home.coda: In 2005 the same person founded Autohome.

china-oicq-to-qq.title: From OICQ to QQ
china-oicq-to-qq.body: Tencent launched OICQ in February 1999 — the O stood for 'Open,' a nod to ICQ. That October, AOL, ICQ's owner, sent a cease-and-desist over trademark infringement. In November 2000, Ma Huateng renamed it QQ, chosen because the letter reads as 'cute' in Chinese.
china-oicq-to-qq.coda: Open was the first word to go once AOL's lawyers arrived.

excite-google-1999.title: Excite Turns Down Google
excite-google-1999.body: In 1999 Google offered to sell itself to Excite for $750,000 plus roughly 1% equity. CEO George Bell judged the search gap too small to justify tearing out Excite's technology. The reasoning held up. Google was worth over a billion within a year.
excite-google-1999.coda: Bell has said since that he would make the same call again.

mars-climate-orbiter-units.title: Pound-Force, Newton
mars-climate-orbiter-units.body: Mars Climate Orbiter went silent during orbital insertion. The board found that the contractor's thruster software output impulse in pound-force seconds while navigation software expected newton-seconds, off by a factor of 4.45. The craft was steered to within roughly 57 km of the surface.
mars-climate-orbiter-units.coda: The $327.6 million mission never transmitted again.

paypal-palm-beaming.title: The Beam That Never Came
paypal-palm-beaming.body: In 1999 Confinity launched infrared cash transfers between Palm Pilots, demoed live at a funding event. Weeks after launch it had roughly 13,000 users, a number that barely moved over the following year. What actually took off was email payments, built only as a fallback option.
paypal-palm-beaming.coda: The company renamed itself PayPal and quietly dropped the beam.

cai-500-yuan.title: The 500-Yuan Salary
cai-500-yuan.body: In 1999 a Hong Kong investment executive traveled to Hangzhou to assess a small website as a possible investment. He found a dozen-odd people coding in one crowded apartment. He didn't invest — he quit his $700,000 salary and joined instead, for 500 yuan a month.
cai-500-yuan.coda: His name was Joe Tsai. He later became Alibaba's executive vice chairman.

gps-week-rollover.title: GPS Week 1024
gps-week-rollover.body: GPS counts weeks in 10 bits, a field that maxes at 1,023 and rolls to zero roughly every 19.7 years. The first rollover hit in August 1999. The second landed on 6 April 2019, breaking receivers built as if the first had been a one-off.
gps-week-rollover.coda: The same overflow is on a schedule and due to recur again in 2038.

foxmail-resold.title: Sold With the Software
foxmail-resold.body: In 1994 a programmer in Guangzhou wrote a free email client in his spare time. In 2000, as the dot-com bubble burst, he sold it to a company and stayed on as tech director. Five years later that company folded and sold the software — and him with it — to Tencent.
foxmail-resold.coda: The programmer was Zhang Xiaolong. Five years after that, inside Tencent, he built WeChat.

danger-duarte-android-reunion.title: Design Director, Failed Startup
danger-duarte-android-reunion.body: In 2000 a designer joined a handheld-device startup founded by Andy Rubin, working on its interface. The company was sold to Microsoft and the team scattered. The designer went on to two other companies over the next decade.
danger-duarte-android-reunion.coda: The designer was Matias Duarte. Ten years later Rubin hired him onto Android.

slashdot-ipod-2001.title: No Wireless, Less Space
slashdot-ipod-2001.body: When Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, Slashdot founder Rob "CmdrTaco" Malda wrote in his editor's note: "No wireless. Less space than a nomad. Lame." Against the spec sheets of rival MP3 players at the time, the line was not factually wrong.
slashdot-ipod-2001.coda: The comment is now cited routinely as the counterexample it produced.

discuz-shenyang-dorm.title: CDB, a dorm build
discuz-shenyang-dorm.body: In 2001, a university student living in a dormitory in Shenyang wrote a piece of forum software and named it Crossday Bulletin, working on it alongside his coursework. The following October he renamed it Discuz.
discuz-shenyang-dorm.coda: On August 23, 2010, Tencent acquired the company he had built around it.

wikipedia-side-wiki.title: A Side Project Next to Nupedia
wikipedia-side-wiki.body: On January 10, 2001, the founder of a peer-reviewed online encyclopedia installed wiki software on the project's own server, mainly so volunteers could try drafting entries loosely on the side while the reviewed encyclopedia moved slowly ahead.
wikipedia-side-wiki.coda: By July 2026 its English edition alone held over 7.2 million articles.

bittorrent-mailing-list.title: A New P2P App
bittorrent-mailing-list.body: On July 2, 2001, a programmer posted a message to a Yahoo eGroups mailing list titled "BitTorrent -- a new P2P app," describing a file-distribution protocol he had just finished designing, one that pulled pieces of a file from many sources at once.
bittorrent-mailing-list.coda: Three years later it accounted for a third of all internet traffic, per a 2004 CacheLogic study.

webvan-thirty-minute-window.title: The Thirty-Minute Window
webvan-thirty-minute-window.body: In 1996 Borders bookstore co-founder Louis Borders started Webvan, promising 30-minute delivery on warehouses built from scratch. It IPO'd in November 1999 for $375 million at a valuation over $4.8 billion, then filed for bankruptcy in July 2001, having lost more than $800 million.
webvan-thirty-minute-window.coda: Some Webvan executives went on to Amazon; Amazon Fresh and Instacart later filled the same order.

kozmo-free-hour-delivery.title: The Free-Hour Promise
kozmo-free-hour-delivery.body: In 1998 Joseph Park and Yong Kang founded Kozmo.com, promising free one-hour delivery with couriers dispatched by pager. It raised roughly $250 million but earned $3.5 million against a $26.3 million loss in 1999. In April 2001, staff learned of the shutdown by finding closed offices.
kozmo-free-hour-delivery.coda: DoorDash, founded in 2013, dispatches couriers by smartphone GPS and charges a delivery fee.

flooz-digital-currency.title: Money With No Store
flooz-digital-currency.body: In February 1999, iVillage co-founder Robert Levitan launched Flooz.com, a digital currency users could buy and spend at partner merchants. A crime ring used stolen cards to mint $300,000 in fraudulent credits, and by 2001 fraud reached 19% of volume. The company folded that August.
flooz-digital-currency.coda: In January 2009, Satoshi Nakamoto mined bitcoin's genesis block.

yahoo-google-2002.title: Yahoo Passes on Google
yahoo-google-2002.body: In 2002 Yahoo CEO Terry Semel offered $3 billion for Google; Page and Brin held out for $5 billion. Semel's read was that Yahoo's own market cap, near $5 billion after the crash, could not absorb that bet. Google went public two years later at $23 billion.
yahoo-google-2002.coda: Yahoo sold its core business to Verizon in 2017 for $4.48 billion.

pplive-dorm-2002.title: Building 26, Yunyuan
pplive-dorm-2002.body: During the 2002 World Cup, Yao Xin's dorm at Huazhong University of Science and Technology had no television, so he watched matches over the campus network, which kept crashing. In his room in Building 26 he started working out how to combine peer-to-peer transfer with streaming video.
pplive-dorm-2002.coda: PPLive launched in 2005 and, at its peak, counted over a hundred million users.

china-alipay-escrow.title: The Escrow Workaround
china-alipay-escrow.body: In 2003, with Taobao buyers and sellers unwilling to trust each other first, finance built an escrow workaround: payment sat frozen until goods were confirmed. The first trade closed that October — a student in Xi'an paying a seller in Japan. The name puns 'pay' and 'guarantee.'
china-alipay-escrow.coda: The pun became the company's permanent, official name.

china-taobao-free-vs-ebay.title: Three Years Free
china-taobao-free-vs-ebay.body: In 2003, eBay's Eachnet held over 70 percent of China's C2C market, charging listing and transaction fees. Taobao launched that May to a near-empty site; Alibaba's answer was three years of free listings. By 2006, Taobao held 70 percent and eBay withdrew from Chinese C2C.
china-taobao-free-vs-ebay.coda: The side still charging listing fees ran out of runway first.

dianping-zagat-notes.title: A Zagat notebook
dianping-zagat-notes.body: In 2002, Zhang Tao came back to China from the United States carrying an idea he had picked up there: the Zagat Survey, a restaurant guide built from readers' own ratings. He registered the domain zsurvey.com and set out to build a Chinese version in Shanghai.
dianping-zagat-notes.coda: Dianping, the site that grew from it, went live on April 12, 2003.

wordpress-b2-post.title: The Blogging Software Dilemma
